evals.prompt: Make a monochrome hand-sketched infographic that explains four states of our AI operations dashboard: today pulse, worker team, worker detail, and integrations. It needs lots of readable UI labels and callout arrows.
evals.expected_output: Selects the handdrawn SaaS wireframe method or explicitly loads references/handdrawn-saas-wireframe.md; Names text fidelity risk and prefers deterministic render or mixed deterministic-plus-texture route; Produces copy inventory before image prompt; Includes style constraints: monochrome, hand-drawn, dense SaaS UI, callout arrows, no gradients or photorealism
assertions: Selects the handdrawn SaaS wireframe method or explicitly loads references/handdrawn-saas-wireframe.md
Names text fidelity risk and prefers deterministic render or mixed deterministic-plus-texture route
Produces copy inventory before image prompt
Includes style constraints: monochrome, hand-drawn, dense SaaS UI, callout arrows, no gradients or photorealism

farplane.expected_behavior: Routes to infographic:handdrawn-saas-wireframe, asks for or invents only clearly marked placeholder copy, creates an Infographic Packet with copy inventory, 2x2 layout spec, shared shell, production route, and proof plan.
anti_patterns: Immediately calls image generation with vague prompt and no copy inventory
Invents factual metrics without marking them illustrative
Treats the reference as a generic dashboard instead of a multi-state product storyboard
